2455-2707-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Reito Sentinel by paying {3}, causing you to put Time Warp on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Warp from the bottom of your library due to River Song during your draw step.
Repeat.

1879-2023-4289-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

225-851-3129-4772-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

654-2557-4365-6441-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

206-215-3443.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven creature cards in your graveyard.
206-215-3443.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding an amount of {B} or {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Deathbloom Ritualist from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Deathbloom Ritualist by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
206-215-3443.notes: Alternate the colors of mana you add each time. If you start adding {B}, you need {G} for Temur Sabertooth and {G} to cast Deathbloom Ritualist

3755-4460-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
3755-4460-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
3755-4460-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

579-2366-5434-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
579-2366-5434-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}{G} due to Mana Reflection.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

2511-4559-4802-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
2511-4559-4802-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Master Biomancer.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

997-2267-7084.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

333-413-2281.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Shepherd of the Cosmos
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Saffi triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Shepherd of the Cosmos trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Saffi enters, Blasting Station triggers. Resolve both Blasting Station triggers from this step and step 4, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 2.
Repeat.

2511-3621-7282.description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard with haste.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the Su-Chi Cave Guard token.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guard token dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.
2511-3621-7282.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can just do step 1 repeatedly.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3129-3899-4359.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

141-5256-7166.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-5256-7166.description:
Cast Dose of Dawnglow by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Dose of Dawnglow.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Dose of Dawnglow
Resolve the Dose of Dawnglow copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-5256-7166.notes: Perform this combo during your main phase to prevent Dose of Dawnglow from causing you to blight.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

2872-4885-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Clever Conjurer.
Activate one of the Clever Conjurer tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Clever Conjurer token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

11-1927-2631-7089.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fire Lord Azula
11-1927-2631-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Alrund's Epiphany by paying its mana cost.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Alrund's Epiphany.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the original Alrund's Epiphany spell.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Alrund's Epiphany spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Alrund's Epiphany and returning the original Alrund's Epiphany to your hand.
Resolve both copies of Alrund's Epiphany from steps 3 and 7, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

1563-3490-4359-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
1563-3490-4359-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

147-2921-5117.description:
Cast Undying Malice by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Undying Malice, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Undying Malice.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Bartolomé del Presidio abilities from step 5.

147-3047-3967.description:
Cast Feign Death by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Feign Death, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Feign Death.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Yahenni abilities from step 5.

3532-5078-6604-6747.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact.
3532-5078-6604-6747.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Clinquant Skymage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

3188-5670-6792--5.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
3188-5670-6792--5.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Repeat.

1365-1379-4853-6797--20.easyPrerequisites:
An opponent was dealt damage this turn.
The creature with bloodthirst does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-1379-4853-6797--20.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving the creature with bloodthirst persist until end of turn.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature with bloodthirst.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, which enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to its bloodthirst ability.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

1339-1808-4050-6625.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Eloise's first and second abilities trigger, causing you to create a Clue token and then to surveil 1.
Matoya triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Repeat.

2438-4871-5626-6415.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing another creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Wriggling Grub from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Wriggling Grub.
When Wriggling Grub dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Wriggling Grub trigger, creating two 1/1 Worm creature tokens.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

413-5972-5973.easyPrerequisites:
Griffin Guide attached to another creature you control.
You control an additional creature beyond those included above and the one that has Griffin Guide attached.
413-5972-5973.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with Griffin Guide attached.
When the creature dies, Cass and Griffin Guide trigger.
Resolve the Griffin Guide trigger, creating a 2/2 Griffin creature token.
When the Griffin enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Cass trigger, returning Griffin Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

191-1689-5437.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one card in hand.
191-1689-5437.description:
Activate Prognostic Sphinx by discarding a card.
Curator of Mysteries triggers, causing you to draw a card due to Eligeth.
Resolve the Prognostic Sphinx ability.
Repeat.

413-1475-4955.notablePrerequisites:
One with the Kami attached to any creature you control.
Grafted Wargear attached to any creature you control except the creature with One with the Kami attached.
413-1475-4955.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with Grafted Wargear attached.
When the creature dies, One with the Kami triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to that creature's power.
When the Spirits enter the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers that many times, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Grafted Wargear's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to a Spirit token.
Repeat.

678-862-1636-5098.notablePrerequisites: Grima Wormtongue does not have summoning sickness.
678-862-1636-5098.description:
Activate Grima Wormtongue by tapping it and sacrificing Crimson Kobolds.
When Crimson Kobolds dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Grima Wormtongue ability, causing target player to lose 1 life.
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1274-1545-4186.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-1545-4186.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1089-4869.notablePrerequisites:
Curiosity attached to Glint-Horn Buccaneer.
You have a number of cards in hand greater than your maximum hand size.
1089-4869.description:
Proceed to your cleanup step, causing you to discard down to your maximum hand size.
Curiosity triggers for each card discarded this way.
Resolve the first trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Curiosity triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining trigger.
After all players pass priority, another cleanup step occurs, causing you to discard down to your maximum hand size.
Repeat from step 2.
